description: This file defines an interface named 'HistoryInterface' for managing and interacting with a history mechanism within the SuiteCRM platform. The interface specifies methods such as getting the first, next, and nth items in history, restoring by timestamp, undoing restore, and appending new items to the history.

classes.name: HistoryInterface
classes.description: An interface that outlines methods for handling a historical record or layout management within the application, including retrieval, restoration, undo, and appending of history items.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the ID of the most recent item in history.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the ID of the next older item in the history.

methods.name: getNth
methods.description: Returns the ID of the nth item in the history, where zero is the most recent.

methods.name: restoreByTimestamp
methods.description: Restores a historical layout based on a given timestamp; returns the timestamp if successful or null on failure.

methods.name: undoRestore
methods.description: Reverts the layout to the state prior to the last restore.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new item to the history and returns its timestamp.
